summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 new fixes (bidirectional WPM<->Speed sync, Record tab quick-record script picker ActionSheet, Teleprompter restart-on-record) plus the library-duration-follows-wpm regression, per agent_to_agent_context_note (backend untouched, not retested). All 4 items PASS on mobile web preview (390x844). No React Native red screens, no JS console/page errors seen in any flow.
action_items: (Minor, cosmetic) src/components/Sheet.tsx generates testID as `sheet-action-${icon}`; since both sample scripts in record.tsx's picker use icon 'document-text-outline', their sheet rows get the SAME testID (duplicate). Not a functional bug (tapping by label text works fine and navigation is correct), but recommend testID=`sheet-action-${index}` or include the action label/id so automated tests and a11y tooling can target specific rows unambiguously.

(Info only, not a bug) 'Kata per menit' Stepper in settings.tsx has no testID prop (unlike 'set-speed'), so its row/+/- buttons render without testID attributes at all. Recommend testID='set-wpm' for consistency and future testability.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx: speedFromWpm/wpmFromSpeed use a fixed WPM_SPEED_RATIO (40/130) with round-to-nearest-5 + clamp; setTele() only derives the counterpart when exactly one of {speed,wpm} is patched, avoiding update loops. Verified clamps correctly at 10/160 (speed) and 80/220 (wpm) and that 135 wpm correctly resolves back to 40 px/s (no unwanted drift), confirming the ratio math is round-trip safe for the default anchor.

library.tsx: new useEffect([wpm, ready]) re-hydrates every script's wordCount/estimatedDuration whenever tele.wpm changes, and persists to storage — verified 'Hook pembuka 7 detik' (22 kata) moved 00:10 (130wpm) -> 00:06 (220wpm) live, no reload needed, across both Scripts tab and Record tab lists in the same render pass.

record.tsx: openQuickRecord() short-circuits to router.push('/camera') with no sheet when recent.length===0 (empty-script edge case handled); ActionSheet actions array correctly maps each script id into a scriptId query param, with 'Rekam tanpa skrip' appended last — all confirmed working via resulting URL (/camera?scriptId=sample_1 vs /camera).

camera.tsx beginCountdown(): teleRef.current?.restart() call is guarded by optional chaining so it's a no-op when there's no script (teleRef still mounts but content is empty string, Teleprompter still renders) — on web, the web early-return (toast 'Perekaman kamera hanya tersedia...') fires before any camera API call, no crash observed with or without scriptId.

success_rate.backend: not tested this session (per request, no backend changes)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 4 requested items (FIX1 speed<->wpm sync + clamp + persistence, FIX2 ActionSheet picker + navigation, FIX3 beginCountdown no-crash with/without script, REGRESSION library durations follow wpm) plus spot-checked core flows (script editor open, Library/Tools tabs, bottom-tab nav) with zero errors

seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded sample_1/sample_2 scripts only; no new scripts/folders created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end in a single browser session (same localStorage) that: (1) set-speed-plus/minus and the untestID'd wpm +/- buttons (located via DOM traversal from the 'Kata per menit' text node) stay mutually consistent and clamp at bounds; settings persist in localStorage key 'promptera.teleprompter' and survive an in-session page.reload(). NOTE: a brand-new Playwright browser context/tool invocation does NOT share localStorage with a prior invocation (separate profile), so cross-tool-call 'persistence' checks will falsely look like a reset to defaults — always verify persistence with page.reload() INSIDE one script, not across separate browser_automation calls. (2) quick-record-button opens the ActionSheet with title 'Pilih skrip untuk teleprompter', both sample scripts, and 'Rekam tanpa skrip'; tapping a script row (resolved via page.get_by_text(label).last) navigates to /camera?scriptId=<id> and the teleprompter text overlay is visible over the web 'device only' placeholder; tapping 'Rekam tanpa skrip' navigates to /camera with no overlay. (3) Tapping record-button on /camera with no script shows the expected info toast with zero console/page errors. (4) Raising wpm to 220 instantly re-computed and re-rendered estimatedDuration for both sample scripts on Scripts tab and Record tab without needing to edit/reload.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the 3 fixes or the regression; only two non-blocking testID/naming code-quality suggestions reported above.
